C1649.title: Record-Breaking Virtual Land Sale Stirs Metaverse Speculation
C1649.summary: In December 2021, a parcel of virtual land on the metaverse platform Decentraland sold for 27.32 million yuan, shattering the platform's previous price record and sparking widespread concern over a speculative bubble in virtual real estate.
